title: VHD (Virtual Hard Disk) signature
summary: A VHD file begins with the 8-byte signature 'conectix' (0x63 0x6F 0x6E 0x65 0x63 0x74 0x69 0x78) at offset 0 (footer) or has the signature at the end of the file.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: VHD is the older virtual disk format (used by Virtual PC, Hyper-V).
VHD supports fixed, dynamic, and differencing disks.
Superseded by VHDX for newer Hyper-V.
